example: The researchers collected information about a disease affecting local trees.
example_translation: 研究人员收集了一种影响当地树木的疾病的信息。
note: 可数的一种疾病；本例不是治疗建议

example: Place the sliced fruit on a clean dish before serving it.
example_translation: 端上水果前，把切好的水果放在干净的盘子上。
note: 本例为容器义；不是一道菜

example: We should not dismiss an idea before hearing the reasons behind it.
example_translation: 在听到一个想法背后的理由之前，我们不应将其否定。
note: dismiss sth；本批不是解雇义

example: The museum will display the restored map next month.
example_translation: 博物馆下个月将展示修复后的地图。
note: 动词；不是陈列名词

example: The sign shows the distance from the village to the lake.
example_translation: 标牌显示了村庄到湖边的距离。
note: the distance from A to B

example: A distant tower became visible when the fog lifted.
example_translation: 雾散后，一座远处的塔显露出来。
note: 本例为距离远；不是关系疏远

example: The two birds have distinct calls that are easy to recognize.
example_translation: 这两只鸟的叫声明显不同，很容易辨认。
note: 本例为有区别的；不是 distant

example: Can you distinguish the old path from the new one on this map?
example_translation: 你能在这张地图上区分旧路和新路吗？
note: distinguish A from B

example: The volunteers organized the distribution of food after the storm.
example_translation: 暴风雨过后，志愿者们组织了食物分发。
note: 不可数过程义；不是地理分布义

example: The old market stands in the northern district of the city.
example_translation: 老市场位于这座城市的北区。
note: 可数区域名词

example: Please do not disturb the students while they are recording the interview.
example_translation: 学生们录制访谈时，请不要打扰他们。
note: disturb sb

example: The instructor taught us how to dive safely into the pool.
example_translation: 教练教我们如何安全地跳入泳池。
note: dive into；本例为跳入水中

example: The festival brings together people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
example_translation: 这个节日让来自不同文化背景的人们聚集在一起。
note: diverse backgrounds；形容词

example: We can divide the work into three smaller tasks.
example_translation: 我们可以把工作分成三个较小的任务。
note: divide sth into parts

example: The division of the land into smaller plots changed the village.
example_translation: 土地被分成更小的地块，改变了这个村庄。
note: the division of sth into parts；本例不是部门

example: The spinning ride made him feel dizzy.
example_translation: 旋转的游乐设施让他感到头晕。
note: feel dizzy；形容词

example: We can do the first task together before working separately.
example_translation: 我们可以先一起完成第一个任务，再分头工作。
note: 本例为实义动词；不是助动词

example: The doctor visited the village clinic every Tuesday.
example_translation: 这位医生每周二都到村里的诊所出诊。
note: 可数职业名词；不是博士义

example: Keep the original document in a dry folder.
example_translation: 把原始文件保存在干燥的文件夹里。
note: 本例为文件名词

example: The dog waited quietly beside the open gate.
example_translation: 那只狗静静地等在敞开的大门旁。
note: 可数动物名词

example: The child placed a small doll beside the pillow.
example_translation: 孩子把一个小玩偶放在枕头旁边。
note: 可数玩具名词

example: The old postcard cost one dollar at the market.
example_translation: 这张旧明信片在市场上售价一美元。
note: 本例指美元；其他国家也使用 dollar

example: A dolphin appeared beside the boat and then slipped beneath the waves.
example_translation: 一只海豚出现在船边，随后潜入波浪之下。
note: 可数动物名词

example: This question belongs to the domain of environmental science.
example_translation: 这个问题属于环境科学领域。
note: the domain of；本批不是互联网域名

example: The airport has a separate terminal for domestic flights.
example_translation: 这座机场为国内航班设有单独的航站楼。
note: 本例与国际的相对；不是家务或驯养义

example: One large company began to dominate the local market.
example_translation: 一家大公司开始主导当地市场。
note: dominate sth；不必添加 over

example: The shop plans to donate warm clothing to the shelter.
example_translation: 这家商店计划向收容所捐赠保暖衣物。
note: donate sth to sb/an organization

example: Please close the door before the wind blows the papers away.
example_translation: 请关上门，免得风把纸张吹走。
note: 可数名词

example: The new dormitory is a short walk from the library.
example_translation: 从新宿舍步行一小段路就能到图书馆。
note: 可数住宿建筑名词

example: The workers received double pay for the extra shift.
example_translation: 工人们因额外值班获得了双倍工资。
note: 形容词；不是翻倍动词

example: There was some doubt about whether the bridge could reopen on time.
example_translation: 人们不确定这座桥能否按时重新开放。
note: doubt about whether...；本例不可数

example: The rainwater flowed down into the narrow channel.
example_translation: 雨水向下流入狭窄的水渠。
note: 副词；本例 down 后没有直接接名词宾语

example: You can download the route before leaving the village.
example_translation: 离开村庄前，你可以下载路线。
note: download sth；动词读音

example: We left the heavy bags downstairs and carried only our notebooks up.
example_translation: 我们把沉重的包留在楼下，只把笔记本带上楼。
note: 本例为副词；不是 downstairs room 的形容词

example: We went downtown to buy supplies before the journey.
example_translation: 旅行前，我们去市中心购买补给。
note: 副词；go downtown 不加 to

example: The baker placed a dozen rolls on the wooden tray.
example_translation: 面包师在木托盘上放了一打小面包。
note: a dozen 后直接接复数名词；不是 dozens of 的概数

example: She read the first draft of the letter before making changes.
example_translation: 修改前，她读了这封信的初稿。
note: 可数稿件名词；不是征召或气流义

example: We had to drag the fallen branch away from the path.
example_translation: 我们不得不把倒下的树枝拖离小路。
note: drag sth；本例不是拖延

example: The story describes a dragon guarding a mountain pass.
example_translation: 这个故事描写了一条守卫山间关口的龙。
note: 可数传说生物名词

example: The class studied a short drama before performing it on stage.
example_translation: 全班先学习了一部短剧，然后把它搬上舞台。
note: 本例为一部戏剧作品

example: The new bridge caused a dramatic change in travel times.
example_translation: 新桥使出行时间发生了显著变化。
note: 本例为变化显著；不是戏剧表演的

example: Can you draw a simple map showing the path to the river?
example_translation: 你能画一张标出河边路线的简图吗？
note: draw sth；过去式 drew，过去分词 drawn

example: She found the old compass in the bottom drawer.
example_translation: 她在最下面的抽屉里找到了旧指南针。
note: 可数家具部件名词

example: His dream is to build a small library for the village.
example_translation: 他的梦想是为村庄建一座小图书馆。
note: 本例为理想；不是睡眠中的梦

example: She chose a simple blue dress for the celebration.
example_translation: 她为庆祝活动挑选了一条简洁的蓝色连衣裙。
note: 可数服装名词；不是穿衣动词

example: The workers will drill a hole through the wooden board.
example_translation: 工人们将在木板上钻一个孔。
note: drill a hole；本例不是训练义

example: We stopped beside the trail to drink some water.
example_translation: 我们在小径旁停下喝了些水。
note: drink sth；过去式 drank，过去分词 drunk

example: She learned to drive on the quiet roads near her home.
example_translation: 她在家附近安静的道路上学会了开车。
note: 本例为驾驶汽车；不是驱使义

example: The driver checked the route before starting the bus.
example_translation: 司机在启动公交车前检查了路线。
note: 可数职业名词

example: The team used a drone to photograph the damaged bridge.
example_translation: 团队用一架无人机拍摄受损的桥梁。
note: 可数飞行器名词；不是雄蜂或嗡嗡声

example: Be careful not to drop the glass bottle on the stones.
example_translation: 小心别把玻璃瓶掉到石头上。
note: 本例为及物使掉落义

example: The long drought reduced the water level in the lake.
example_translation: 长期干旱使湖泊水位下降。
note: 可数的一次干旱；读音不要与 draft 混淆

example: The rescue team reached the swimmer before he could drown.
example_translation: 救援队在那位游泳者可能溺亡之前赶到了他身边。
note: 本例为不及物；不是被动 drowned 的固定要求

example: Each drug in the study was labelled with a code.
example_translation: 研究中的每种药物都标注了一个代码。
note: 本例为药物名词；不是非法毒品义

example: Keep a dry pair of socks in a separate bag.
example_translation: 在单独的袋子里放一双干袜子。
note: 形容词；不是弄干动词

example: A duck swam slowly across the pond.
example_translation: 一只鸭子慢慢游过池塘。
note: 可数动物名词；不是低头躲避动词

example: She placed a freshly cooked dumpling in each bowl.
example_translation: 她在每个碗里放了一个刚煮好的饺子。
note: 本例采用中式饺子义

example: The duration of the walk depends on the weather and the route.
example_translation: 步行持续多久取决于天气和路线。
note: the duration of sth

example: The library remained open during the repairs.
example_translation: 图书馆在维修期间仍然开放。
note: 介词；后接表示时间段或活动的名词

example: A thin layer of dust covered the unused desk.
example_translation: 不用的书桌上覆盖着一层薄薄的灰尘。
note: 不可数名词；不是除尘动词

example: It is our duty to leave the campsite clean for the next visitors.
example_translation: 让营地保持干净以供下一批访客使用，是我们的责任。
note: it is one's duty to do sth

example: The club has a dynamic leader who welcomes new ideas.
example_translation: 这个俱乐部有一位充满活力、欢迎新想法的负责人。
note: 本例描述人；不是动力学术语

example: The museum displays pottery from a dynasty that ruled centuries ago.
example_translation: 博物馆展出了一些统治于数百年前的王朝时期的陶器。
note: 可数历史名词

example: Each traveller carried a small notebook and a pencil.
example_translation: 每位旅人都带着一本小笔记本和一支铅笔。
note: 限定词；each 后接单数名词

example: The children were eager to hear the end of the story.
example_translation: 孩子们急切地想听故事的结尾。
note: eager to do sth

example: An eagle circled above the valley in the morning light.
example_translation: 晨光中，一只鹰在山谷上方盘旋。
note: 可数猛禽名词

example: The child held the shell close to one ear.
example_translation: 孩子把贝壳贴近一只耳朵。
note: 本例为身体部位；不是谷穗义

example: We arrived early to help prepare the room.
example_translation: 我们提前到达，帮忙布置房间。
note: 副词；不是 early train 的形容词

example: She hopes to earn enough money to buy a new bicycle.
example_translation: 她希望挣够钱买一辆新自行车。
note: earn money；本例不是赢得尊重义

example: The earth moves around the sun.
example_translation: 地球围绕太阳运行。
note: 通常与 the 连用；也常写作 Earth

example: The town inspected its bridges after the earthquake.
example_translation: 地震后，小镇检查了当地的桥梁。
note: 可数事件名词

example: With practice, she could read the map with ease.
example_translation: 经过练习，她能够轻松读懂地图。
note: with ease；不可数名词

example: The hills to the east were covered in morning mist.
example_translation: 东面的山丘笼罩在晨雾中。
note: 名词；to the east

example: The eastern side of the lake receives sunlight first.
example_translation: 湖的东侧最先照到阳光。
note: 形容词

example: The first part of the route is easy to follow.
example_translation: 路线的第一段很容易辨认。
note: 形容词；easy to do

example: We can eat a simple meal before leaving the village.
example_translation: 离开村庄前，我们可以吃一顿简单的饭。
note: eat sth；过去式 ate，过去分词 eaten

example: She chose a course in ecology to learn how living things interact.
example_translation: 她选择了一门生态学课程，了解生物如何相互作用。
note: 不可数学科名词；不是生态环境的唯一译法

example: The report examines the economic effects of the new railway.
example_translation: 报告研究了新铁路带来的经济影响。
note: 与 economical 节约的区分

example: Tourism plays an important role in the local economy.
example_translation: 旅游业在当地经济中发挥着重要作用。
note: the local economy；本例不是节约义

example: We stopped at the edge of the forest to check the map.
example_translation: 我们在森林边缘停下查看地图。
note: at the edge of；名词

example: The editor checked the dates before publishing the article.
example_translation: 编辑在发表文章前核对了日期。
note: 可数职业名词

example: The project aims to improve access to education in remote villages.
example_translation: 这个项目旨在改善偏远村庄接受教育的机会。
note: 不可数名词

example: An experienced educator helped design the new course.
example_translation: 一位经验丰富的教育工作者帮助设计了新课程。
note: 可数人物名词

example: The new lighting had a noticeable effect on the room's atmosphere.
example_translation: 新的照明对房间氛围产生了明显影响。
note: have an effect on sth；不是 affect 动词

example: The new system is more efficient because it avoids repeated work.
example_translation: 新系统避免了重复工作，因此效率更高。
note: 形容词；与 effective 有效的区分

example: It took a great deal of effort to clear the fallen trees.
example_translation: 清理倒下的树木花费了很大力气。
note: 本例不可数；make an effort 也常见

example: She added one egg to the mixture and stirred it slowly.
example_translation: 她往混合物里加了一个鸡蛋，慢慢搅拌。
note: 可数食物名词

example: Either route will take us to the village before sunset.
example_translation: 两条路线中的任一条都能让我们在日落前到达村庄。
note: 限定词；either 后接单数名词

example: Her elder sister taught her how to read the map.
example_translation: 她的姐姐教她如何看地图。
note: 通常用于兄弟姐妹关系；不用 than 表比较

example: The centre offers a quiet space for elderly visitors.
example_translation: 这个中心为年长访客提供了一个安静的空间。
note: 形容词；避免把人仅按年龄概括

example: The club held an election to choose its next chair.
example_translation: 俱乐部举行了选举，选出下一任主席。
note: hold an election

example: An electric pump moved water from the tank to the garden.
example_translation: 一台电动泵把水从水箱送到花园。
note: 本例为用电驱动；不是 electronic 电子的

example: The village regained electricity after the workers repaired the line.
example_translation: 工人们修好线路后，村庄恢复了供电。
note: 不可数名词

example: The students used an electronic dictionary during the exercise.
example_translation: 学生们在练习中使用了电子词典。
note: 形容词；与 electric 区分

example: The gallery displayed an elegant wooden chair with simple lines.
example_translation: 画廊展出了一把线条简洁、造型精美的木椅。
note: 本例为设计美观义

example: Trust is an essential element of a successful team.
example_translation: 信任是成功团队的一个基本要素。
note: an element of sth；本例不是化学元素

example: The elephant moved slowly towards the river.
example_translation: 那头大象缓缓走向河边。
note: 可数动物名词

example: We used the elevator to carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
example_translation: 我们用电梯把沉重的箱子搬上楼。
note: 美式常用；英式常用 lift；不要自动互认拼写

example: A careful check can eliminate errors before the report is published.
example_translation: 仔细检查可以在报告发表前消除错误。
note: eliminate sth；本例不是淘汰对手义

example: Is there anything else we should bring for the journey?
example_translation: 这趟旅行还有什么其他东西需要带吗？
note: 放在不定代词等后面；anything else
